sources.title: Large Language Models for Norwegian - Department of Informatics
sources.snippet: Technical details NorMistral-11B-thinking features 11 billion parameters and is based on the Mistral-Nemo-Base-2407 model by Mistral AI. The base model first underwent a very large-scale continual pre-training on Norwegian data (about 250 billion tokens), acquiring fluency in Bokmål, Nynorsk and Saami languages.
